For the other TCP traffic, 'GEOIP' and 'IP-CIDR' are supported. Since quantumult has a function called PROXY, sure it can redirect your traffic to remote proxy servers. But be clear, we do NOT provide any server side service or support, you should build your own servers.

See it can accelerate your network connection if you set your filter right, and of course the filter is totally customizable.
